data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2023 the Syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 3,045.2m. During 2023 there was a material gross reduction in prior year reserves of GBP 1,271.2m (a release of ~41.7% of opening gross reserves), primarily driven by the RiverStone reinsurance-to-close and quota share transactions which transferred discontinued 2018-and-prior (and certain 2019/2020) liabilities out of the Syndicate, together with favourable prior-year claims development and reinsurance recoveries. These RITC transactions materially distorted the primary statements and reduced gross technical liabilities, while the retained book also saw favourable development reflecting a benign claims year and reserve releases.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2023, prior period reserves were reduced by GBP 25.3 million (2022: strengthened by GBP 34.6 million), representing a reduction of 1.9% of the claims ratio (2022: increase of 3.3% to the claims ratio).

This substantial improvement in profitability reflects a combination of a more benign claims environment across the portfolio, premium growth, the elimination of the drag of discontinued classes, better risk selection, greater retention of risk, and improving risk adjusted rate change.

The movements arising from prior year claims line above includes movements relating to RiverStone contracts entered into during the current and prior year, with the movements explained further in note 4.
These impacts were partially offset by strengthening to reserves outside of the best estimate for ongoing man-made global events.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross opening reserves and prior year movement taken from the Statement of Financial Position (claims outstanding) and Note 12(a) 'Movements arising from prior year claims' (Insurance liabilities column). The large 2023 RiverStone RITC and quota share transactions materially distort both the balance sheet and reserve movement figures (note 4). The sentence quoting a GBP 25.3m reduction is a net (after reinsurance) figure referenced in the narrative; the authoritative gross prior-year movement used is -GBP 1,271.2m from the technical note. Per-LOB gross prior-year movement amounts are not provided; lob movements are inferred and amounts set to null. Claims development triangle (gross) was extracted and provided; the triangle excludes 2018 and prior UW years due to the RITC extinguishment.
